briefdescription.para: hasSameValue - Return true if this ARM constpool value can share the same constantpool entry as another ARM constpool value.

detaileddescription.para: This is used to represent PC-relative displacement between the address of the load instruction and the constant being loaded, i.e. (&GV-(LPIC+8)).
